exact_statement: The prior all-dimensional twelve coherent same-fiber edit theorem remains at K=4+2/ln(2). For any quadratic q on n uniform original physical bits with polar matrix Q, Q_i nonzero, P={partial_i q=1}, g=(-1)^q*(1-2*1_E), and |E intersect P^c|<=2^n/32, let J exclude i and satisfy Q_ij=0 and Q_j not in span_F2(Q_i) for each j in J. There is NO pairwise noninteraction hypothesis. With I_J=sum_j Inf_j(g), H(g)-average_a H(g|J=a)<=K I_J and I(g)=I_J+average_a I(g|J=a). For every adaptive prefix T querying only unused J coordinates, retain all full conditional leaves, let D_T be its actual weighted entropy debit, R_T its full remaining-J completion debit and A_T its actual weighted queried influence. Then D_T+R_T=H(g)-average_a H(g|J=a), A_T+sum_v w_v I_Jv(g_v)=I_J, and K I_J-D_T-R_T>=0, with the same original I_J account. Neither local K4 goodness in descendants nor D_T<=K A_T is asserted. An exact tagged ten-bit parent has a reached physical query with B_k>4 Inf_k despite the paid whole block. Arbitrary tagged half-cube leaves A_h have H(A_h)=2+H(h)/2 and I(A_h)=1+I(h)/2; uniformly paying all such leaves at a dimension-independent rate would imply full FEI by tensor amplification.
hypotheses: Uniform physical cube, Boolean signs, base-two spectral entropy; Q alternating over F2.
Inside edits arbitrary; outside edit density at most1/32 of the whole cube.
Commit to one original physical J; each prefix queries only unused J coordinates and retains full completion leaves.
Remaining committed J influence is reserved, never charged again as a full child FEI budget.
External composition is conditional on supplied eligible blocks; arbitrary terminal payment and universal selection are unproved.
